page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Jedi General?

A member of the Jedi Order participated in the Clone Wars, fighting for the Galactic Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems planet Altyr V for the Republic.

The Jedi general was mentioned in "Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic," an article written by Karen Traviss and Ryan Kaufman. The guide was published in Star Wars Insider 84,
